issues: UI authentication flow does not attach the JWT token to protected API calls, causing 401 responses on /dashboard/summary, /receipts and subsequent endpoints. The frontend does not store the token after login/registration or does not include it in the Authorization header for subsequent fetch calls.

TypeScript compilation fails (tsc) – tsconfig.json in the project root (or frontend) has an empty include/exclude configuration, resulting in "No inputs were found" error. This blocks static validation and prevents proper type‑checking of the frontend code.
High‑severity security vulnerabilities are present in the frontend dependencies (react‑router 7.14.1). Trivy reports CVEs that need to be fixed by upgrading to a safe version (≥7.14.2 or latest).

CORS configuration uses a wildcard origin ("*") which is flagged by the security linter. While not a hard blocker, it should be restricted to known origins (e.g., http://localhost) to meet best practices.
feedback:
The backend appears functional (unit and integration tests pass) but the end‑to‑end UI flow fails because the JWT token is never sent with protected requests. Update the frontend authentication logic: after a successful login (or auto‑login after registration) store the access_token (e.g., in localStorage or a React context) and modify the API wrapper (or each fetch call) to read that token and include an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header automatically. 

Fix the TypeScript configuration: ensure tsconfig.json (and any root tsconfig) correctly includes the source files (e.g., "include": ["src/**/*.ts", "src/**/*.tsx"]) and does not exclude all files, so `tsc` succeeds. 

Upgrade the vulnerable react‑router dependency to a version without the reported CVEs (e.g., 7.14.2 or newer) and run `npm install` to lock the safe version. 

Optionally tighten the CORS policy in `backend/app/main.py` by removing the wildcard and specifying explicit origins, or at least document the decision. Once these issues are addressed, the acceptance tests should pass and all static validation checks will be green.
